name: yugo-memory
description: Private, event-driven, full-fidelity conversation memory with calibrated local hybrid recall.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve long conversations and recall exact evidence quickly.
interface.longDescription: Stores only conversations that cross Codex's compaction boundary, keeps raw JSONL as the source of truth, and combines exact-anchor lookup, multilingual FTS, multi-facet late interaction, LSH candidate generation, sparse graph expansion, evidence-set calibration, incremental indexing, and bounded raw verification without a server.
defaultPrompt: Recall the exact decisions from our earlier long conversation.
